note: The script asks for the title card, four lower thirds, the oldest-child text card and the end card, so 6 graphics and the end card, all 16:9. The CASS logo file is not in endcards/ yet, so the end card types CASS until it is added.

mg.title: Title card
mg.cue: Title card, full frame on CASS navy #2C2B77: large Vista Colina Family Shelter, small under it Central Arizona Shelter Services with no period after Services.
mg.use: Full frame from 00:06 to 00:09, music only. No period after Services.

mg.title: Lower third Ian
mg.cue: Lower third at 00:10 for 3 s: Ian Snyder · Client
mg.use: Put it on at 00:10 for 3 s, lower left above the captions. No period.

mg.title: Lower third Crystal
mg.cue: Lower third at 00:26 for 3 s: Crystal Singleton / Program Manager, Vista Colina Family Shelter
mg.use: Put it on at 00:26 for 3 s, lower left above the captions. Type the second line Program Manager, Vista Colina Family Shelter under the name, and make the bar wide enough.

mg.title: Oldest child card

text.main: Here, the work starts with the oldest child.

mg.cue: Text card, full frame on CASS navy #2C2B77: Here, the work starts with the oldest child.
mg.use: Full frame from 00:33 to 00:37, music only. Let it breathe.

mg.title: Lower third Bri
mg.cue: Lower third at 00:37 for 3 s: Bri / Case Manager, Vista Colina Family Shelter
mg.use: Put it on at 00:37 for 3 s, lower left above the captions. Type the second line Case Manager, Vista Colina Family Shelter under the name, no period.

mg.title: Lower third Brittnie
mg.cue: Lower third at 00:59 for 3 s: Brittnie Stanton / Chief Program Officer, CASS
mg.use: Put it on at 00:59 for 3 s while she is on camera, lower left above the captions. Type the second line Chief Program Officer, CASS under the name.

mg.title: End card
mg.cue: End card: CASS logo, then the line For more information on Vista Colina Family Shelter visit CASSAZ.org.
mg.src: No CASS end card or logo in endcards/ yet (checked 3 Nov 2026), so CASS is typed. Line from the script's end card row (CASS's own Vista Colina wording); colours from the CASS brand (navy #2C2B77, white).

text.name: CASS
lines: For more information on Vista Colina Family Shelter visit CASSAZ.org

mg.use: Dissolve in under <invaluable> at about 01:19 and hold to the end. Swap in the CASS logo once it is in the repo.
